# CDL Tanker (N) Endorsement Training

> 1-hour online course for drivers adding the Tank Vehicle (N) endorsement to a CDL, based on 49 CFR Part 383. Prepares learners for the state N endorsement knowledge test. Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com).

## Key facts
- Duration: 1 hour; 2 lessons plus final exam (80% to pass)
- Credits: 0.1 CEU
- Price: $49.99 per person; bulk pricing available
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7; certificate available immediately after passing
- Prerequisite: valid commercial driver's license
- Tank vehicle definition: any single tank of 119 gallons or more, or multiple tanks totaling 1,000 gallons or more, permanently or temporarily attached
- FMCSA-reported entry-level driver training is required for Class A, B and C and the H, P and S endorsements, not for N; the N endorsement requires passing the state tank vehicle knowledge test
- Hazardous liquids or gases in tanks require the X endorsement (H + N)
- State acceptance: every state except Washington

## Lessons
1. Regulatory Overview (FMCSA requirements, CDL tank endorsement rules, permits, route considerations, driver responsibilities)
2. Tank Vehicles Operation and Inspection (baffled, bulkhead and smooth-bore tanks; liquid surge; pre-trip checks of valves, manhole covers, hoses and emergency shutoffs; curves, ramps and partial loads)

## Learning objectives
- Inspect tank vehicles for structural integrity, leaks, valves and safety equipment
- Explain how liquid surge and a high center of gravity affect stability
- Calculate outage (ullage) when loading
- Apply safe driving techniques on curves, ramps and slippery roads
- Respond to emergencies such as brake failure or vehicle instability

## Who should take it
CDL holders adding N to a Class A or B license; H-endorsed drivers working toward X; dry van or flatbed drivers hauling liquid totes or IBCs; drivers of fuel, food-grade liquids or bulk industrial products.
